info.name: SpeakBetter API - Interactive Learning
info.description:
Complete API collection for the SpeakBetter Interactive Learning platform.

Base URL: https://interactive-learning.test/api/v1

All endpoints (except login) require Bearer token authentication.

item.name: 1. Authentication
item.description: Student login/logout using symbolic codes (no passwords).

request.description:
Login with student symbolic code.

Available codes: STD10101 - STD10120 (Group 1), STD20101 - STD20101 (Group 2)

Returns: student info + Bearer token

⚠️ Save the 'token' from response for all subsequent requests.
Logout and invalidate the current token.

item.name: 2. Scenarios
item.description: Browse available conversation scenarios (8 scenarios total).

request.description:
Get all 8 scenarios with titles, descriptions, vocabulary, and learning goals.

Scenarios:
1. Introducing Yourself
2. Daily Routines and Changes
3. Hobbies and Interests
4. Asking for Information
5. Describing People and Places
6. Opinions and Preferences
7. Giving Suggestions
8. Narrating Past Events

Get details of a specific scenario by ID (1-8).

Returns: title, communicative_function, vocabulary[], completion_criteria

item.name: 3. Sessions
item.description:
Create, start, manage, and end learning sessions.

Session Flow:
1. Create session (pick scenario)
2. Start session → Ahmad greets
3. Advance phases: intro → vocab → conversation → feedback → closing
4. End session

request.description: List all sessions for the logged-in student.

Create a new session for a scenario.

Body:
- scenario_id: 1-8
- session_number: 1-10 (optional, default 1)

Returns: session object with ID

Start a session. Ahmad greets the student.

Returns:
- data.reply: Ahmad's greeting text
- data.audio: base64-encoded MP3 (Ahmad's voice via ElevenLabs)
- data.audio_format: 'mp3'
- data.scenario: { title, vocabulary[], communicative_function, number }
- data.phase: { current_phase, remaining_total, remaining_in_phase, timeline[] }

⭐ This is where the session begins. Phase starts at 'intro'.
Get session details including all conversation turns.

Get current phase timing info.

Returns:
- phase.current_phase: 'intro' | 'vocab' | 'conversation' | 'feedback' | 'closing'
- phase.remaining_total: seconds remaining in 40min session
- phase.remaining_in_phase: seconds remaining in current phase
- phase.timeline: array of phase objects with { key, label, is_current, is_done }

Move to the next phase.

Phase order: intro → vocab → conversation → feedback → closing

Returns:
- data.phase: updated phase info
- data.message: Ahmad's message for the new phase
- data.audio: base64 MP3 of Ahmad saying the message
- data.audio_format: 'mp3'
- data.done: true if session is complete (after closing phase)

End session early or after completion.

Returns:
- stats.total_turns: total conversation turns
- stats.student_turns: student's turn count
- stats.correct_turns: correct responses
- stats.duration_seconds: total session time
- stats.duration_formatted: 'M:SS'

item.name: 4. Conversation
item.description: The core conversation API — student speaks, Ahmad responds.

request.description:
Send student's speech text to Ahmad. Ahmad responds with AI-generated reply + audio.

Body:
- text: student's speech (from browser Speech Recognition)
- confidence: 0.0-1.0 (speech recognition confidence)

Returns:
- data.reply: Ahmad's text response
- data.audio: base64 MP3 (Ahmad's voice)
- data.audio_format: 'mp3'
- data.feedback_type: 'none' | 'recast' | 'clarification' | 'model'
- data.feedback_level: 0 (correct) | 1 (recast) | 2 (clarification) | 3 (model)
- data.feedback_text: the corrective feedback text
- data.attempt_count: which attempt (1-3)
- data.done: true if conversation phase should end

⭐ This is the MAIN API — handles LLM (GPT-4o-mini) + TTS (ElevenLabs)

Convert any text to Ahmad's voice (ElevenLabs cloned voice).

Used for:
- Speaker test in system check
- Vocabulary word pronunciation
- Any text that needs Ahmad's voice

Returns:
- data.audio: base64 MP3
- data.audio_format: 'mp3'

item.name: 5. Simli (Avatar Animation)
item.description:
Simli integration for lip-sync animated avatar.

Flow:
1. Get session token from backend
2. Use token to connect SimliClient (WebRTC)
3. Send audio data to Simli for lip sync

request.description:
Get Simli session token (proxied through backend to protect API key).

Returns:
- session_token: string (use with SimliClient)
- face_id: the Simli face ID

Get ICE servers for WebRTC NAT traversal.

Returns: array of ICE server objects
